[check 6] At 360px, text runs past the edge of the screen and is cut: "Aldie, Virginia" (x 296 to 404), "Founder · 2018 →" (x 321 to 453), "A" (x 341 to 397). Set display type in clamp() with a vw term so it fits the column, and let lines wrap.

1. (Judgment 4) At 360, fold 1 ends on the "FEATURED WORK — SPACEMAN LLC" label. SPACEMAN starts cut off at the top of fold 2, and the caption sits entirely in fold 2. That breaks `first_fold`, which asks for mark, label band, SPACEMAN and caption together. At 1440 SPACEMAN only just clears the bottom edge, and the h1 caption the hero-zone spec puts in the first screen falls below it. The cause at both widths is the empty dot field, which takes about 60% of the fold. Cut it to a band behind or beside the title so SPACEMAN and the caption both sit in the first fold.

2. (Judgment 6) The mark is declared "top-left of the specimen field", but at 1440 it sits halfway down the field, under the dot block. Move it to the top-left corner of the field once the spacer is cut.

3. (Judgment 1) Tonight reads as a rerun of the recent specimen nights. It takes 2026-10-19's "type specimen on warm paper" with a ~50° gold on light-ground/dots, and pairs it with the exact small-caps/roman/heavy/justified/stacked treatment and "foundry specimen" register of 2026-10-26 (46° brass gold) and 2026-10-21. Change at least two of hue family, ground material and type treatment so a returning visitor doesn't take it for one of those nights.

4. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman standfirst says each of Zeldman, Rolex, The Nature Conservancy, Intuit and LastPass "hired that single person for both ends of the needle", "from first sketch through shipped product". The record says the work was "sometimes as a solo contributor, sometimes embedded in a larger team" and makes no per-client claim about design plus build. Rewrite it to the record's wording. Separately, "SPACEMAN.US →" contradicts the record's liveUrl, which is https://spaceman.llc.

5. (Judgment 2) In the client logo grid, the LastPass logo renders as "LastP ss•••" and a solid green disc sits on top of The Nature Conservancy wordmark. Both read as broken images. Fix the assets or set those names as type like Zeldman and Framebridge.

1. (Judgment 1) Tonight reads as a rerun of 2026-10-26. That night was also "a foundry specimen of the work" in gold (46° vs tonight's 48°). It used the same small-caps/roman/heavy/justified/stacked type register and the same horizontal/full-bleed/crowded/accelerating/no-shell/type-dominant tuple, and its hero "Deep in both. Not a generalist." makes the same one-person-both claim. 2026-10-21 is the same gold small-caps justified specimen again. Break the resemblance on at least the hue or the type register, and move the specimen-sheet vocabulary off the gold-on-paper reading, so a returning visitor cannot mistake this for that week.
2. (Judgment 3) At 1440 the lead artifact title breaks mid-word as "SPACEM / AN" across two lines. The declaration calls for the single word tracked to justify edge to edge across the field. Set SPACEMAN on one line spanning the saffron field, with tracking rather than a wrap filling the width, as it already does at 360.

1. (Freshness) The page reads as a rerun of 2026-10-26's "foundry specimen of the work." It repeats a gold hue (48° against 46°), the identical small-caps/roman/heavy/justified/stacked type register, the full-bleed/crowded/accelerating/type-dominant tuple, and a hero that restates "Deep in both. Not a generalist." as one person doing both. The one trait meant to separate tonight was the paper ground, and the mockup dropped it. Restore the light sand ground (page `#F6EDDB`, text `#191409`) so a returning visitor sees a printed sheet, not a third gold-on-dark specimen after 10-21 and 10-26.

6. (Declarations: SHELL `ground_strategy: light-ground`) The image shows a near-black `#191409` page with cream text. That is the declared dark-flip palette used as the default, which makes it effectively dark-void. Set the page, rail, client list, index and colophon on the paper ground with the declared text colours. Keep the saffron dotted field as the single flooded element.
